# netbox_l2vpn_termination (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/vpn/l2vpntermination/):

> An L2VPN termination attaches a VLAN, an interface or a VM interface to an L2VPN.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_l2vpn_termination" "example" {
  l2vpn_id             = netbox_l2vpn.example.id
  assigned_object_type = "ipam.vlan"
  assigned_object_id   = netbox_vlan.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `assigned_object_id` (Number) The ID of the assigned object associated with the l2vpn termination.
- `assigned_object_type` (String) The assigned object type of the l2vpn termination.
- `l2vpn_id` (Number) The ID of the l2vpn associated with the l2vpn termination.

### Optional

- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_l2vpn_termination.example 1
```
